$comment: Media the importer sideloads, and how the page files refer to it. Page files never carry a real attachment id or URL — those do not survive a move between sites — so they carry a token and the importer swaps it for the value it got on sideload. See fixtures/base-three-page/README.md, 'Import tokens'.
$status: BOTH FILES ARE PLACEHOLDERS, not photography. They are drawn as the same hatched plate the design uses for an empty image slot, so neither can be mistaken for a real studio photo. They are real files on purpose: shipping the slots empty would leave the attachment-id remapping path — the one an install most often gets wrong — untested at import. Replace both with licensed, compressed photography before this design is released.
$consent: The before-and-after slots in the results block ship EMPTY, with briefing notes rather than placeholder images. Client photographs are personal data and, in this niche, special category data; the template must not ship anything that could be mistaken for a real client's face, and the customer must add each one only with written consent. See the privacy policy this design ships with.
